scripts.build: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); if(require('fs').existsSync('frontend/package.json')){execSync('npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')&&!fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){fs.cpSync('dist','frontend/dist',{recursive:true})}else if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')&&!fs.existsSync('dist')){fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true})}"
